abstract: BACKGROUND: Malignant struma ovarii is a rare type of germ cell tumor that is most often diagnosed postoperatively. The natural history and optimal treatment regimen for the disease are essentially unknown due to the small numbers of published cases. CASE: A 32-year-old woman presented with pelvic pain and an ovarian mass that was ultimately treated by total abdominal hysterectomy/bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Postoperatively, she was diagnosed with a malignant struma ovarii. The patient was subsequently treated with thyroidectomy and I(131) ablation and is currently disease free. A Medline literature search was performed and clinical data from 23 additional cases were compiled. CONCLUSION: In this review of 24 cases, 16 patients were followed conservatively postoperatively while 8 received varied additional therapy (4 with I(131)). There were 8 recurrences and all occurred in the conservatively managed patients. I(131) for recurrent disease provided an initial complete response in 7 women. Treatment with thyroidectomy and I(131) should be considered in the first line of management for malignant struma ovarii.

背景：悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は稀な胚細胞腫瘍であり、術後に診断されることが多い。症例数が少ないため、自然経過と最適な治療法は基本的に不明である。
症例：32歳女性が骨盤痛と卵巣腫瘤で受診し、全腹式子宮全摘術・両側付属器切除を受けた。術後に悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。その後、甲状腺全摘術とI-131アブレーションを受け、現在も無病である。Medlineで文献検索を行い、追加の23例の臨床データを集めた。
結論：24例の検討で、16例は術後に経過観察され、8例は追加治療（うち4例はI-131）を受けた。再発は8例で、いずれも経過観察群に生じた。再発例へのI-131療法は7例で初回完全奏効をもたらした。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の初期治療として甲状腺全摘術とI-131療法を考慮すべきである。
